info.description: A heading over a short index line, two paragraphs, and three photographs arranged as a collage. ⚠ The collage geometry — which frame is masked, which pops, the zoom on each — is design and stays in the page. Only the words and the three photographs are here.

kicker.description: Optional small label above the heading.

headingSecond.description: The second line of the heading. The page puts the line break in.

index.description: The short list under the heading — one word or two per entry.

imageOneAlt.description: ⚠ NOT REQUIRED, AT THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTION — a photograph can now be published with nothing here, and it will be silent to a screen reader and to search. Please still write it, and write what the picture SHOWS. If you replace the picture, replace this too: a description left behind describes the wrong image, which no text check can catch.
